data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew roots 'bil' (God) and 'lat' (gift). Billat can be interpreted as 'God's gift' or 'God has given'. In Christianity, this name holds symbolic value for those who believe that God has bestowed them with unique blessings and abilities. The name Billat carries the meaning “God's gift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Billat usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Βιλλάτος

in_latin.name: Bilatus

in_english.long_meaning: An English name derived from the Hebrew name בילת (Billat). It preserves the original meaning of the Hebrew name, indicating swiftness or hastiness. The shorter form 'Bill' is a common English variant.
